name: Arms Crossed
description: Cross both arms to express skepticism, disagreement, or a firm stance.

name: Cat Monster Rawr
description: A playful pretend-monster "Rawr!": cat claws held up beside the face, then a few kitten-like alternating claw swipes. Use for mock roaring, teasing or silly intimidation.

name: Cheeky Finger Guns
description: Point playful finger guns to punctuate a joke, cheeky compliment, or confident agreement.

name: Double Peace Pop
description: Pop both hands into peace signs to celebrate, greet enthusiastically, or pose playfully.

name: Double Thumbs Down
description: Give two thumbs down to express strong disapproval, rejection, or playful disappointment.

name: Double Thumbs Up
description: Give two thumbs up to express enthusiastic approval, encouragement, or celebration of success.

name: Finger Heart Pose
description: Raises a Korean finger heart beside the cheek with a wink and a smile while a little heart pops up above the crossed fingers. Use to express affection, appreciation, or a sweet thank-you.

name: Hands on Hips
description: Place both hands on the hips to express confidence, determination, or playful impatience.

name: Heart Hands
description: Bring both hands together into a heart to express warm affection, gratitude, or support.

name: Left OK Sign
description: Make an OK sign with the left hand to confirm that something is correct, ready, or going well.

name: Left Peace Sign
description: Raise a left-hand peace sign for a friendly greeting, reassurance, or a casual celebratory pose.

name: Right Face Palm
description: Cover the face with the right hand to react to an obvious mistake, awkward moment, or exasperating situation.

name: Right Finger Point
description: Point with the right index finger to emphasize a key point, offer a reminder, or playfully call something out.

name: Right Thumbs Down
description: Give a right-handed thumbs down to express disapproval, disagreement, or disappointment.

name: Right Thumbs Up
description: Give a right-handed thumbs up to express approval, agreement, encouragement, or reassurance.

name: Shy Finger Poke Loop
description: Repeatedly tap the index fingers together to sustain a bashful, nervous, or hesitant mood while speaking.

name: Hand on Heart
description: Place one hand over the heart to convey sincerity, heartfelt gratitude, empathy, or a personal promise.

name: Salute
description: Give a salute to acknowledge a request, show respect, or playfully signal readiness to help.

name: Thinking Hand on Chin
description: A light, held thinking pose: thumb under the jaw and index finger along the cheek while the eyes wander and the finger taps once. Use while considering a question or weighing options.

name: Thinking Head Scratch
description: Scratch the head to express puzzlement, uncertainty, or an attempt to work something out.
